ArkTS卡片开发中常见的适配问题和解决方案
当您希望将应用的关键信息或常用操作以卡片形式展示在用户桌面或锁屏上，实现信息一目了然、服务一步直达的用户体验时，应使用 Form Kit
典型场景包括：天气应用在桌面展示实时天气卡片、待办应用在桌面展示任务列表卡片、音乐应用在锁屏展示播放控制卡片、运动应用在桌面展示今日运动数据卡片等
当您需要开发带有交互动效的趣味卡片（如卡片小游戏、动态场景展示），或需要卡片支持自定义绘制、自定义字体、动效等高级 UI 能力时，应选择 ArkTS 卡片开发方式
当您的卡片需求较为简单且团队熟悉 Web 开发范式时，可选择 JS 卡片开发方式

实现卡片点击后跳转到应用指定页面 / Open a specific app page when the widget is tapped
在卡片里处理按钮点击和消息回传 / Handle button actions and message callbacks inside the form
管理卡片的创建、更新、删除和生命周期事件 / Manage form creation, updates, deletion, and lifecycle events
为待办事项应用添加可交互桌面卡片 / Add an interactive home-screen widget for a todo app
在卡片中展示实时状态并按需刷新界面 / Display live status in the form and refresh the UI on demand
拉起卡片添加页面引导用户把小组件放到桌面 / Launch the add-form page to guide users to place the widget on the desktop
开发带动画和自定义绘制效果的 ArkTS 卡片 / Build an ArkTS form with animations and custom drawing effects
preconditions: 工程已集成HarmonyOS Form Kit能力，且目标设备形态支持服务卡片（不含轻量级智能穿戴） / The project includes HarmonyOS Form Kit capability, and the target device type supports forms (excluding lightweight wearables)
卡片提供方模块已正确声明并配置卡片相关文件与元数据（如 form_config.json 及对应资源） / The form provider module has correctly declared and configured form-related files and metadata (such as form_config.json and related resources)
若卡片需要展示网络图片或联网数据，应用已声明所需网络权限且运行环境可访问目标网络资源 / If the form displays network images or online data, required network permissions are declared and the runtime can reach the target network resources
inputs: 卡片配置文件与卡片类型信息 / form configuration file and form type information
卡片页面资源与UI描述代码 / form page resources and UI description code
卡片展示数据与刷新参数 / form display data and refresh parameters
卡片交互事件参数（message、router、call） / form interaction event parameters (message, router, call)
outputs: 服务卡片实例（Form，包含唯一 formId，可添加到桌面、锁屏等系统界面） / Form instance with a unique formId that can be added to launcher, lock screen, and other system surfaces
ArkTS 声明式卡片界面产物（动态卡片或静态卡片，支持动效、Canvas、自定义字体） / ArkTS declarative form UI artifact, either dynamic or static, with animation, Canvas, and custom font support
JS 卡片界面产物（HML、CSS、JSON 类 Web 卡片渲染结果） / JS form UI artifact rendered from HML, CSS, and JSON web-like resources
FormBindingData 数据绑定对象（创建卡片或刷新卡片内容时返回/提交的数据载体） / FormBindingData object used as the data payload returned or submitted when creating or refreshing a form
更新后的卡片内容（主动刷新、定时刷新、按状态刷新、本地图片或网络图片刷新后的显示结果） / Updated form content after active refresh, scheduled refresh, state-based refresh, or local/network image refresh
FormInfo 卡片元数据对象或列表（卡片名称、尺寸、类型、能力等信息） / FormInfo metadata object or list containing form name, dimensions, type, capabilities, and related information
message 事件消息负载（卡片向应用传递的用户操作或业务消息） / message event payload carrying user actions or business messages from the form to the application
router 事件跳转请求（从卡片跳转到应用指定页面的目标信息） / router event navigation request containing the target information for opening a specific application page from the form
call 事件后台拉起结果/请求数据（卡片触发应用 UIAbility 在后台处理业务） / call event background invocation result or request data for triggering an application UIAbility to process work in the background
互动卡片运行产物（趣味交互/小游戏卡片、场景动效卡片） / Interactive form runtime artifact such as a fun-interaction mini-game form or a scene-animation form
锁屏卡片渲染结果（锁屏界面展示的重要信息或快捷操作卡片） / Lock-screen form rendering result showing key information or quick actions on the lock screen
背板透明卡片渲染结果（透明背景视觉样式的服务卡片） / Transparent-background form rendering result with a see-through visual style
卡片发布或加桌结果（应用内拉起卡片管理后生成的桌面卡片或返回的发布标识） / Form publishing or add-to-home result, such as the created launcher form or returned publishing identifier

postconditions.statement: 工程中已新增或修改卡片配置，使系统能够识别该服务卡片 / The project adds or updates form configuration so the system can recognize the service form
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify form-related configuration files or metadata (for example form_config.json or equivalent module declarations) defining a HarmonyOS form?

postconditions.statement: 已实现卡片界面或卡片逻辑代码，而非仅停留在普通页面实现 / Form UI or form logic code is implemented, rather than only ordinary app page code
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include form-specific UI or lifecycle/event handling code indicating a HarmonyOS form provider implementation, not just a normal page or ability?

postconditions.statement: 若需求涉及刷新或交互，代码中已接入对应的卡片刷新机制或message/router/call事件处理 / If refresh or interaction is required, the code wires in the corresponding form refresh mechanism or message/router/call event handling
postconditions.judge_prompt: When the requested feature mentions refresh or interaction, do the edits include corresponding form refresh handling or message/router/call event logic?
